note: Real OSM footprints and road alignments with procedural tileable facade atlases. Licensed Manila photographs are retained as reference images and are not falsely represented as building-specific photogrammetry. This improves tiling artifacts but is not a photogrammetry reconstruction.
facade_texture_source: locally generated tileable facade atlases; Wikimedia Commons images retained as attributed reference only
facade_texture_method: four distinct repeatable facade atlases with window frames, reveals, sills, and material variation; no whole-street photographs stretched across walls
